local_review.finding_body: FS-test-contract.2.9 and FS-contribution-contract.4.8 prohibit making a runtime repair green by removing the failing behavior. The baseline obtains its LoggerContext through LoggerFactory.getILoggerFactory(), but the 1.5.30 test replaces that integration path with new LoggerContext() and manually constructs LogbackServiceProvider. Reproducible artifact evidence shows META-INF/services/org.slf4j.spi.SLF4JServiceProvider is present in the 1.5.29 and 1.5.31 JARs but absent from the 1.5.30 JAR; the supplied preflight record independently identifies this as the upstream 1.5.30 packaging defect. Consequently the green tests prove direct Logback APIs while bypassing the broken SLF4J provider discovery that caused the reported JVM failure. Restoring that path cannot be repaired within the contribution without supplying a fake missing artifact resource or testing a different version. FS-contribution-contract.5.4 does not apply because this is a JVM packaging defect, not dynamic access reachable only through behavior unsupported by Native Image, so disposition 5.5 requires human intervention. Separate contribution-local violations were repaired: a deleted baseline context-selector scenario, three explicit 5-second socket timeouts, and machine-local /tmp resource metadata produced by passing a temporary model as a path rather than a file URI.
local_review.finding_title: Runtime repair bypasses missing SLF4J provider registration
local_review.fix_note: Restored the removed default ContextSelector scenario, raised explicit socket timeouts to the required 10-second floor, passed the temporary serialized model as a file URI, removed the resulting machine-local resource entries, and let Forge finalization regenerate stable statistics. The exact finalization command then completed successfully without further publishable changes.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the full coordinate-scoped diff, local gate evidence, old/new dynamic-access statistics, and the finalized repaired tree. The repair coverage gate passes: overall 16/16 to 16/17, reflection 15/15 to 15/15, and resources 1/1 to 1/2 all preserve covered-call counts. The exact Forge finalization command completed successfully and proved all three native lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test validity, and regenerated statistics stable. The contribution still bypasses the JVM failure instead of preserving SLF4J provider discovery, so it requires maintainer intervention.
